description: "The Boy Travellers in Mexico" by Thomas Wallace Knox is a travel narrative written in the late 19th century. The book recounts the adventures of two youths, Frank and Fred, as they journey through various regions of Mexico, including Central Mexico, Campeche, and Yucatán, while also providing insights into the culture, history, and geography of the land.
